issues.on_page: Grants/Donations 25,044 (p2: Capital Grants and Contributions, Policy/administration)
issues.issue: The notes say 'category other, detail_category Grants (user ruling 2026-11-12)', but the JSON has donations/contributions here and in detail[5]. The notes and the data disagree, and that ruling is not in the extractor rules. Mixed grant/donation line; category is a judgment call.

This is sales tax collected on utility billings and paid back out (Sales tax expense 18,824), not the village's own sales tax revenue. The statement-level receipts count the same money as Utility Charges in 'Electric' 417,881. Same for detail[51] (1,005) and detail[64] (2,261).
Not in the 'Capital Outlay: <function>' form the rules require. Same for detail[41] (Special Revenue Equipment 5,200, function streets/highways).
Refuse spending in the General Fund is categorized as utilities. It is already marked for review; general government or health/welfare are also defensible.
